name: FRTX
description: RTX-style post processing for Geometry Dash: emissive bloom, clarity and cinematic colour grading.

enabled.name: Enable FRTX
enabled.description: Master switch. When off the game renders completely untouched and no GPU memory is used.

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: 0 = Custom, 1 = Subtle, 2 = Showcase, 3 = Overkill. Anything other than Custom overrides every slider below, so set this to 0 before tuning by hand.

bloom-enabled.name: Bloom: Enabled
bloom-enabled.description: Makes bright objects, glow and particles bleed light into their surroundings.

bloom-intensity.name: Bloom: Intensity
bloom-intensity.description: How strongly the blurred highlights are added back on top of the scene.

bloom-threshold.name: Bloom: Threshold
bloom-threshold.description: Brightness a pixel must reach before it starts to glow. Lower values make more of the screen bloom.

bloom-knee.name: Bloom: Soft Knee
bloom-knee.description: Softness of the threshold. 0 is a hard cutoff, higher values fade highlights in gradually.

bloom-emissive-bias.name: Bloom: Emissive Bias
bloom-emissive-bias.description: Biases the glow towards saturated colours, so neon and glow objects bloom hard while bright backgrounds stay put. Pure white still glows. Turn this down if you want everything bright to bloom equally.

bloom-radius.name: Bloom: Radius
bloom-radius.description: Scales the blur step size. Larger values spread the glow further at the cost of some fidelity.

bloom-levels.name: Bloom: Quality
bloom-levels.description: Number of blur levels. 1 is a tight glow and cheapest, 3 gives a wide cinematic falloff.

bloom-scale.name: Bloom: Resolution Scale
bloom-scale.description: Resolution of the bloom buffers relative to the screen. Lower is faster and slightly softer.

bloom-spread.name: Bloom: Spread
bloom-spread.description: How large the halo around a light source reads. Low values keep the glow tight against the object; high values let the widest blur levels through and give the big soft halo of showcase footage.

streak-intensity.name: Streaks: Intensity
streak-intensity.description: Horizontal anamorphic light streaks off bright points, like a cinema lens. Off by default: showcase levels glow radially rather than streaking. Needs bloom enabled.

streak-length.name: Streaks: Length
streak-length.description: How far the streaks reach across the screen.

clarity.name: Clarity: Amount
clarity.description: Local contrast. Lifts edge and material detail so the frame reads as though it has depth. This is doing most of the work in making the picture look three dimensional. 0 disables it.

clarity-radius.name: Clarity: Radius
clarity-radius.description: Radius in pixels. Small values sharpen and can halo, larger values give broad depth instead.

tonemap-enabled.name: Grade: Filmic Tonemapping
tonemap-enabled.description: Applies an ACES filmic curve so bright areas roll off smoothly instead of clipping to white.

exposure.name: Grade: Exposure
exposure.description: Overall brightness multiplier applied before tonemapping.

black-point.name: Grade: Black Point
black-point.description: Crushes the darkest values to true black. A little of this is most of what separates graded footage from a filter.

split-shadow.name: Grade: Shadow Tone
split-shadow.description: Tints the shadows only. Positive values cool them towards blue, which is the classic cinematic split.

split-highlight.name: Grade: Highlight Tone
split-highlight.description: Tints the highlights only. Positive values warm them towards orange.

temperature.name: Grade: Temperature
temperature.description: Whole-image white balance. Negative values cool towards blue, positive values warm towards orange.

tint.name: Grade: Tint
tint.description: Negative values push towards magenta, positive values towards green.

vignette.name: Lens: Vignette
vignette.description: Darkens the corners of the screen. 0 disables it.

chromatic.name: Lens: Chromatic Aberration
chromatic.description: Splits red and blue towards the edges of the screen, like a real camera lens. 0 disables it.

grain.name: Lens: Film Grain
grain.description: Adds animated noise. Keep this very low; 0 disables it.

dither.name: Lens: Dithering
dither.description: Adds an imperceptible amount of noise to hide colour banding in smooth gradients.

debug-view.name: Debug View
debug-view.description: 0 = normal, 1 = captured scene only, 2 = bloom only, 3 = streaks only. Useful when tuning the threshold and the emissive bias.
